description: This is a shell script (.sh) used for building, testing, and measuring code coverage in a C++ project involving multiple components such as Thunder, ThunderTools, entservices-apis, and AppGateway. It automates cloning repositories, applying patches, configuring and building dependencies with CMake, executing tests, generating coverage reports, and staging plugin shared libraries, all tailored for a CI environment with coverage considerations.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the system PATH.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific git tag/branch/commit in a repository directory.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a git repository and checks out specified ref, handling re-clone if requested.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch file to a repository directory, with idempotency handling.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a CMake project with optional extra args.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_noinstall
methods.description: Configures and builds a CMake project without installation (for build-only steps).

methods.name: stage_all_plugins_from_dir_best_effort
methods.description: Copies plugin shared libraries from a source directory to staging directory, best effort.
